sources.title: Taykhoom/RNAErnie · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: RNAErnie is a BERT-based RNA language model pretrained on RNACentral using a motif-aware masking strategy with type-guided fine-tuning. It uses a DNA-style vocabulary (T instead of U) and extends the token vocabulary with 28 ncRNA type labels to enable type-guided learning.
